tasks.name: Tell who can reach each application right now
tasks.operator_answer: portal-home (https://portal.lab.test/, https://portal-alias.lab.test/) is serving on 192.0.2.10:443 (private_or_lan) with declared mode='public' ('anyone'), anonymous access, and per-IP rate_limit; dashboard (https://dash.lab.test/) is serving on 192.0.2.10:443 with declared mode='restricted' ('family'), HTTP Basic (dashboard.htpasswd) + WAF block mode, and withdrawn='no'; unmatched hosts hit first-declared default-deny (404).

tasks.name: Share a private dashboard with a small group
tasks.surface_used: jul plan / jul apply / jul postcondition + client curl from lab-client-1 and lab-client-2 (runbook §4 Step 2 & Step 4)
tasks.operator_answer: Installed Basic auth + restricted intent on loopback first (02-loopback-dashboard-restricted.toml, class='narrowed'), verified 401/200 on loopback, then moved default-deny, portal, and dashboard to 192.0.2.10:443 in one atomic candidate (jul.toml, class='uncertain'), confirmed postcondition='candidate_serving', and verified excluded LAN client gets 401 (origin_delta=0) while intended LAN client gets 200.

tasks.name: Publish a public site on the same instance without exposing the dashboard
tasks.surface_used: jul plan / jul apply / jul postcondition + GET /api/sharing + client curl (runbook §4 Step 3 & Step 4)
tasks.operator_answer: Published portal.lab.test and portal-alias.lab.test (route_id='portal-home', mode='public') with rate_limit enabled and Jul cache off while keeping default-deny first on 192.0.2.10:443; verified anonymous 200 on portal, 404 on unknown Host/IP literal, and 401 on dash.lab.test without Basic credentials.

tasks.name: Withdraw access to the dashboard and confirm the result
tasks.surface_used: jul plan / jul apply (05-lan-withdrawn-gate.toml) / jul postcondition + GET /api/sharing + client curl (runbook §4 Step 5 & §6)
tasks.operator_answer: Applied withdrawn=true on route_id='dashboard' (class='narrowed', retirement_bound='2s'), verified postcondition='candidate_serving', confirmed GET /api/sharing reports withdrawn='yes' and last_retirement.claim='complete_withdrawal' (completed_within_bound=true, collateral_count=0), and verified client curl receives 403 Forbidden with Cache-Control: no-store while portal.lab.test stays 200 OK; then restored jul.toml.

tasks.name: Diagnose a misconfiguration or dependency failure without widening access
tasks.surface_used: GET /api/sharing + systemctl status jul-f1-dashboard.service + client curl
tasks.operator_answer: Identified two distinct failure classes without loosening auth: (1) intent_restricted_unenforced warning in GET /api/sharing when a restricted entry lacks Jul checks or external_enforcer, and (2) 502 Bad Gateway for authenticated dashboard callers during backend stop while unauthenticated callers are still denied 401 at Jul and portal.lab.test stays 200 OK.

tasks.name: Hand off or resume after a restart or external file edit
tasks.surface_used: jul status + GET /api/sharing + jul apply --adopt-external + jul stage / systemctl restart / jul plan / jul postcondition (runbook §5)
tasks.operator_answer: Observed managed_drift after external file edit and resolved via adopt-external; observed separate serving vs saved layers in GET /api/sharing during managed_pending_restart (pre-restart postcondition='not_serving_yet'); after systemctl restart rotated boot_id, observed pre-restart postcondition='unverifiable' ('planned_by_earlier_process') and re-ran jul plan + jul postcondition to confirm 'candidate_serving'.
